43:3: Undoubtedly We made it an Arabic Qur'an so that you may reason.
43:4: Undoubtedly it, in Our presence, is in the Mother of the Book, elevated, full of wisdom.
43:5: Shall We turn the Remembrance away from you and withhold it because you are a transgressing people?
43:6: How many a prophet We sent among the earlier ones.
43:7: No prophet would come to them but that they were mockers of him.
43:8: So We destroyed those of greater strength than them, and the example of the earlier ones passed.
43:9: And if you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?', they would surely say, 'The al-Aziz and the al-Alim created them.'
43:10: He who made the earth a cradle for you and made paths in it for you so that you may be guided.
43:11: He who sent down water from the sky by a measure, and with it We gave life to a dead land. Thus you will be brought forth.
43:12: He who created all pairs and made for you things from ships and animals that you ride.
43:13: So that you may settle on its back, then when you settle upon it, mention your Rabb's blessing and say, 'Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, and we were not capable of it.'
43:14: And undoubtedly, we are those who will return to our Rabb.
43:15: And they assigned to Him a part from His servants. Undoubtedly man is a clear ungrateful one.
43:16: Or did He take daughters from what He created and choose sons for you?
43:17: And when one of them is given glad tidings of that which he set forth as an example for ar-Rahman, his face turns pitch-black and he is swallowing back rage.
43:18: Is it one who is brought up in ornaments and who is not clear in dispute?
43:19: And they made the angels, those who are servants of ar-Rahman, female. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be written and they will be questioned.
43:20: And they said: 'If ar-Rahman had willed, we would not have worshipped them.' They have no knowledge of this; they do nothing but fabricate lies.
43:21: Or did We give them a book before it so that they are holding fast to it?
43:22: Rather they said, 'Undoubtedly we found our fathers upon a community, and undoubtedly we are rightly guided upon their footsteps.'
43:23: Thus, We sent no warner to any city before you without its affluent ones saying, 'Undoubtedly we found our fathers upon a religion, and undoubtedly we are followers upon their footsteps.'
43:24: He said: 'Even if I brought you a more guided way than that which you found your fathers upon?' They said: 'Undoubtedly we are deniers of that with which you were sent.'
43:25: Thereupon We took retribution from them; so look at how the end of the deniers was.
43:26: When Abraham said to his father and his people: 'Undoubtedly I am clear of that which you worship,'
43:27: 'Except the One who created me, for undoubtedly He will guide me.'
43:28: And he made it a lasting word for those who came after him so that perhaps they might return.
43:29: Rather, I made them and their forefathers enjoy benefits until the truth and a clear messenger came to them.
43:30: When the truth came to them, they said, 'This is magic, and we are deniers of it.'
43:31: And they said: 'If only this Qur'an had been sent down to a great man from one of the two cities!'
43:32: Is it they who apportion your Rabb's mercy? We apportioned their livelihood among them in the worldly life and raised some of them above others in degrees so that some of them might take others as servants. Your Rabb's mercy is better than what they gather.
43:33: If people were not going to become a single community, We would have made roofs of silver and stairways upon which they ascend for the houses of those who disbelieve in ar-Rahman.
43:34: And doors for their houses, and couches upon which they recline.
43:35: And ornaments too. All of this is the temporary enjoyment of the worldly life. The Hereafter, in the presence of your Rabb, is for the righteous.
43:36: Whoever turns away from the remembrance of ar-Rahman, We assign to him a devil, and he becomes his companion.
43:37: Undoubtedly they hinder them from the path, and they think that they are rightly guided.
43:38: Finally, when he comes to Us, he says, 'I wish there were between me and you the distance of the two easts; what an evil companion!'
43:39: That Day it will never benefit you, because you wronged; you are partners in the punishment.
43:40: Will you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind and him who is in clear error?
43:41: Even if We take you away from them, undoubtedly We are takers of retribution from them.
43:42: Or We show you that which We promised them; surely We have full power over them.
43:43: So hold fast to what was revealed to you; undoubtedly you are on a straight path.
43:44: Undoubtedly it is surely a reminder for you and your people, and soon you will be questioned.
43:45: Ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before you: Did We make deities to be worshipped besides ar-Rahman?
43:46: By oath, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: 'Undoubtedly I am the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds.'
43:47: When he came to them with Our signs, immediately they were laughing at them.
43:48: We showed them no sign but that it was greater than the other, and We seized them with punishment so that perhaps they might return.
43:49: They said: 'O sorcerer! Supplicate to your Rabb for us according to the covenant He made with you. Undoubtedly we will be guided.'
43:50: Yet when We removed the punishment from them, they immediately broke their word.
43:51: Pharaoh called out among his people, he said: 'O my people! Is not the dominion of Egypt mine? And these rivers, do they not flow beneath me? Do you not see?'
43:52: Or am I not better than this one who is contemptible and can hardly express himself clearly?
43:53: Should not golden bracelets have been cast upon him, or angels come with him rank upon rank?
43:54: Thus he belittled his people, and they obeyed him; undoubtedly they were a defiantly disobedient people.
43:55: Thus, when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
43:56: Thus We made them a thing of the past and an example for later generations.
43:57: When the son of Mary is presented as an example, immediately your people laugh at it.
43:58: And they said: 'Are our gods better, or he?' They presented him to you only for dispute. Rather, they are a hostile people.
43:59: He is only a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
43:60: If We willed, We would surely have made angels from you to succeed you in the earth.
43:61: And undoubtedly it is knowledge for the Hour, so do not ever doubt concerning it and follow me; this is a straight path.
43:62: And never let Satan hinder you; undoubtedly he is a clear enemy to you.
43:63: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he said: 'I have come to you with wisdom and to clarify to you some of that about which you dispute. So fear Allah and obey me.'
43:64: Indeed Allah, He is my Rabb and your Rabb, so worship Him, this is a straight path.
43:65: But the groups differed among themselves, so woe to those who wronged from the punishment of a painful day!
43:66: Do they wait for anything other than the Hour of Resurrection that will come upon them suddenly, while they do not realize?
43:67: On that day, friends will be enemies to one another, except those of taqwa.
43:68: He says: 'O My servants, today there is no fear for you, nor will you grieve.'
43:69: Those who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
43:70: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, being gladdened.
43:71: Golden platters and cups will be circulated around them, and in it is whatever the souls desire and the eyes take pleasure in.
43:72: And this is the Paradise which you are made to inherit because of what you used to do.
43:73: For you in it are many fruits, from which you eat.
43:74: Indeed, the criminals will abide eternally in the punishment of Hell.
43:75: The punishment will not be lightened for them, and they are left in despair therein.
43:76: And We did not wrong them, but they were the wrongdoers.
43:77: And they cried out: 'O Malik! Let your Rabb put an end to us.' He said: 'Indeed, you are to remain.'
43:78: By oath, We brought you the truth, but most of you dislike the truth.
43:79: Or have they decided upon a matter? Indeed, We too are deciders.
43:80: Or do they think that We do not hear their secrets and their whispers? Yes, Our messengers are beside them writing.
43:81: Say: 'If the Rahman had a child, I would be the first of the worshippers.'
43:82: The Rabb of the heavens and the earth, the Rabb of the Arsh is exalted above their descriptions.
43:83: So leave them to plunge and play until they meet their day which they are promised.
43:84: And He is the deity in heaven and the deity on earth, and He is the Possessor of judgment, the Knower.
43:85: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour of Resurrection, and to Him you will be returned.
43:86: Those whom they pray to besides Him do not possess intercession, except those who testify to the truth knowingly, they intercede.
43:87: By oath, if you were to ask them who created them, they would surely say: 'Allah.' How then are they turned away?
43:88: And his saying is: 'O my Rabb, indeed these are a people who do not believe.'
43:89: So turn away from them and say: 'Peace,' soon they will know.
